title: examples/minimal-game addon copy is stale and fails strict mode
body: examples/minimal-game/addons/stagehand/autoload/stagehand_server.gd is a third, drifted copy of the addon. It still has the preload-const-shadowing pattern (const StagehandCommandRouter/StagehandJsonRpc/StagehandInputSimulator/StagehandPropertyHandler/StagehandScreenshotCapture := preload(...), lines 10-14) that collides with the global class_names, plus discarded connect()/_send_to_peer() return values (e.g. lines 114, 124). It is an older snapshot (no return-value capture on _send_to_peer, no self-quit-on-bind-failure logic). Same fix as godot-stagehand-gls applies. Not edited here because it is outside the canonical+testdata lockstep scope.

title: testdata addon core copies drifted from canonical (lockstep broken)
body: testdata/test_project/addons/stagehand/core/expression_evaluator.gd and method_handler.gd have diverged from the canonical addons/stagehand/core/ versions in behavior, not just whitespace. expression_evaluator: canonical uses params key 'context_node', testdata uses 'selector'. method_handler: canonical has an allow_multiple feature returning a 'results' array; the testdata copy lacks it entirely (only first-match 'return_value'). The repo invariant 'keep canonical and testdata addon copies in lockstep' is already violated for these files. The testdata copy appears stale and should be re-synced from canonical (then re-tested).
